title: Interior areas for improvement
summary: This topic is dominated by vague references to interior or entry/exit areas that could be improved, with only isolated clearly positive and clearly negative examples.

positive.summary: One positive review says BMW's material quality, detail, and service have improved over time.

negative.summary: One negative review says an unspecified area needs improvement because it is not good enough.

undetermined.summary: Most fragments mention things that could be improved in broad terms such as interior or getting in and out, but they do not identify a clear evaluative stance on a specific feature.

limitations: The topic appears lexically clustered around the word 'improved' and combines broad prompts about improvement with a few concrete opinions, so the examples do not form a tightly specific theme.
Most sampled fragments are generic and lack enough detail to identify the exact component being discussed, despite keywords such as cupholders and comfort.
Known-sentiment evidence is very limited, so concrete positive and negative aspects are insufficiently represented.
